7.reason: 'two days earlier' has two natural readings: before Sunday (key 'had left') or earlier than planned ('Priya told me that her older brother would leave for summer camp two days earlier' = ahead of schedule, a normal future-in-the-past report). Nothing in the sentence rules out the second reading, so a student picking 'would leave' has a reasonable complaint. Fix: 'two days before' or 'on Friday'.

batch_patterns.evidence: Sentence Completion keys by letter: D,A,A,A,D,D,A,B,D,A,D,D = A5 B1 C0 D6. 11 of 12 completion keys are at the outer positions A or D (about 0.3% chance if positions are uniform). C is never the key. Across all 24 items the counts are A8 B4 C3 D9. Error Identification keys (A3 B3 C3 D3) are balanced, so the skew is all in completion.

Pairs test the same point on the same frame, so solving one gives the other away: 11/12 careful vs carefully (comparative adverb, then adverb after 'handles'); 8/18 'should have [been] ...' passive with 'but nobody remembered'; 6/7 both 'Priya' plus a past-perfect key ('had followed', 'had left').
